description.checks: FastImage works at all in an Expo app (the Expo example, on iOS, Android and the web): an image loads, a missing one fails, reload() after a failure, a bundled image, several sizes, preload, and the cache methods (on the web, that getCachePath isn't supported).

smoke-load.checks: A remote image loads: onLoad with its size, then onLoadEnd with ok: true and the same size.
smoke-load.steps: Loads the 200×200 photo of a pug in a blanket from the image server (a new url each run). Passes when onLoad gave 200×200 and onLoadEnd's result is { ok: true, width: 200, height: 200 }.
smoke-load.shows: The pug photo in a small square.

smoke-error.checks: A missing image fails: onError with a message, then onLoadEnd with ok: false and an error.
smoke-error.steps: Loads a url the image server answers with a 404. Passes when onError's error isn't empty and onLoadEnd's result is { ok: false, error } with an error that isn't empty.
smoke-error.shows: An empty gray square: the image never loads.

smoke-reload.checks: reload() on the ref loads an image again after its request failed.
smoke-reload.steps: Loads the pug photo from a url the image server answers with a 503 the first time and the image after. On onError, calls the ref's reload(). Passes on the onLoad that follows; a second onError, or a ref without reload(), fails.
smoke-reload.shows: The pug photo in a small square. A failure leaves an empty gray square.

smoke-bundled.checks: A bundled image (require()) loads, at the size of its file.
smoke-bundled.steps: Shows require('./images/logo.png'), the 1000×1000 React logo. Passes when onLoad's size is 1000×1000.
smoke-bundled.shows: The light blue React logo on a small gray square.

smoke-sizes.checks: A source of several sizes loads the one that fits the view: on iOS and Android the one closest to the view's size in pixels, on the web the smallest at least as wide (the browser picks it from a srcset).
smoke-sizes.steps: Gives a 96 dp view three sizes of a square from the image server: 100 px (red), 300 px (green) and 900 px (blue). Passes when onLoad's width is the size expected for the screen's pixel ratio: 300 px on the test phones (3× on iOS, 2.625× on Android) and on the web (its page is at 3×).
smoke-sizes.shows: A solid green square, larger than the other rows' images. Red or blue means the wrong size was loaded.

smoke-preload.checks: FastImage.preload resolves with a result per source: ok with the size for an image that loads, not ok for a missing one.
smoke-preload.steps: Preloads a 120×120 photo and a url the image server answers with a 404, when it mounts. Passes when the first result is { ok: true, width: 120, height: 120 } and the second isn't ok.
smoke-preload.shows: An empty gray square: the images are only preloaded, not shown.

smoke-cache-path.checks: FastImage.getCachePath gives the file of an image a view has loaded.
smoke-cache-path.steps: Loads a 120×120 photo of the northern lights; on onLoad, calls FastImage.getCachePath with the same source. Passes when the result is ok with a path.
smoke-cache-path.shows: The northern lights photo (green sky over a dark tree) in a small square.

smoke-cache-limits.checks: FastImage.configureCache() reports the cache limits the app's config sets with FastImage's Expo config plugin.
smoke-cache-limits.steps: Calls FastImage.configureCache() without changes when it mounts. Passes when it reports maxDiskSize 150 MB, maxDiskAge 7 days and maxMemorySize 50 MB, as in app.config.js.
smoke-cache-limits.shows: An empty gray square: nothing loads here.

description.checks: Features that on Android go through the Glide components FastImage registers itself when the app's AppGlideModule is expo-image's: onProgress, cache: 'web', writeToCache, SVG and APNG images. iOS runs the same cases.

smoke-progress.checks: onProgress comes while a remote image downloads, the last one with all of it loaded, before onLoad. On Android in an app with expo-image, it goes through the Glide components FastImage registers itself.
smoke-progress.steps: Loads the pug photo from the image server with onProgress. Passes on onLoad if the last onProgress had loaded equal to total.
smoke-progress.shows: The pug photo in a small square.

smoke-web-cache.checks: A source with cache: 'web' uses the HTTP cache: loaded twice from a url the server marks as cacheable, it's requested once.
smoke-web-cache.steps: Loads the pug photo with cache: 'web' from a url the image server sends with Cache-Control: max-age=3600, then mounts a new view for it once it has loaded. After the second onLoad, removes the view and asks the image server how many times the url was requested; passes on 1.
smoke-web-cache.shows: An empty gray square: the image view is gone after the second load.

smoke-write-to-cache.checks: FastImage.writeToCache stores a file as a url's image, which a view then shows from the cache without downloading it.
smoke-write-to-cache.steps: Downloads a 120×120 photo of the northern lights with FastImage.getCachePath, then calls FastImage.writeToCache with the pug photo's url and that file. Then shows the pug url with cache: 'cacheOnly'; passes when onLoad's width is 120 (the stored file, not the 200×200 pug).
smoke-write-to-cache.shows: The northern lights photo (green sky over a dark tree) in a small square. The pug, or an empty gray square, is a failure.

smoke-svg.checks: An SVG image from a url loads. expo-image brings the SVG libraries into this app too, so this doesn't check that FastImage includes them (the main example does).
smoke-svg.steps: Loads a 24×24 SVG of a black ring from the image server. Passes on onLoad.
smoke-svg.shows: A thick black ring on a small gray square.

smoke-apng.steps: Loads an APNG of two frames, red then blue, 400 ms each and looping. On onLoad, records the image for 1.6 s (two plays). Passes when the recording sees both red and blue.
smoke-apng.shows: A red or blue square (animated, so it's not compared). The recording sees red and blue in turn.

smoke-apng-blur.checks: An animated PNG (APNG) with blurRadius shows its first frame, blurred and still. On Android in an app with expo-image, Glide also has APNG4Android's plugin for APNGs, which ignores Glide's "don't animate" option.
smoke-apng-blur.steps: Loads an APNG of two frames, red then blue, 400 ms each and looping, with blurRadius 4. On onLoad, records the image for 1.6 s (two plays). Passes when the recording sees red only.
smoke-apng-blur.shows: A red square (animated images are masked, so it's not compared). The recording sees red only; never blue.

description.checks: expo-image works next to FastImage in the same app.

expo-image.checks: expo-image's Image loads in the same app as FastImage. On Android both use Glide, and the app's AppGlideModule is expo-image's (FastImage leaves its own out), so expo-image keeps its own setup.
expo-image.steps: Loads a 120×120 photo of a bear on rocks from the image server with expo-image's Image (a new url each run). Passes on onLoad; onError fails.
expo-image.shows: The bear photo in a small square.
